name: Precarious Footing

source.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

disable: DC 18 Survival check (trained) to weather the collapse safely; DC 20 Crafting check (trained) to stabilize the ground

items.name: Lava Bath
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps into the pit or within 5 feet of its edge

---
Effect The ground crumbles apart and the creature slides into the lava. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling. Otherwise it falls 20 feet (taking 10 fall damage) and is exposed to lava, taking 6d6 fire damage per round of contact. Climbing the crumbling rock face requires a successful DC 20 Athletics check check.

text: The ground around the lava pit is crumbling and unstable.
